title: Sergeant Larson's onion speech on secrecy

tellings.quote: during our during our black introduction. He went into the onion thing.

plain: A former sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says a US intelligence agency trained him to receive messages from aliens, says that in the early 1990s at an overseas base, a Sergeant Larson gave his group "the onion thing," a talk on secrecy as layer upon layer, during their "black introduction," the briefing that brought them into a secret program. Sherman tells it first-hand on the show and in his book Above Black, as part of how he was told the program was hidden.
